propositions: Central immutable OperationSnapshot must capture validated non-secret effective configuration values with explicit provenance source kinds and repository root selection across CLI, library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points in shadow mode without altering authoritative execution.

Composition precedence must enforce explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, with repository root selected independently as explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level/current directory.

Snapshot construction must reject secret wrappers, live capability/client objects, and authentication objects; secret sentinels must be absent from serialization, fingerprinting, diagnostic output, and all schema boundaries.

Malformed selected operation config must raise typed config error before lock, subprocess, network, or store writes; all other snapshot assembly failures must be caught, emit redacted warnings, and preserve authoritative operation behavior.
Shadow mode is enabled by default via REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW and can be disabled by canonical false value without altering stored ticket/bridge formats or creating rollback dependencies.

Representative ordinary ticket/store, LLM-gate, and reconcile operations must produce identical immutable snapshot values and fingerprints across all entry points when given identical five-layer inputs.
